item: Calls, forms, referral emails, WhatsApp/SMS, voicemail, website enquiries
allowed_no_sensitive_evidence: Channel names, timestamps, owner/status fields, redacted sample categories
owner_question: Where do family and referral enquiries first land and who owns callback ageing?
excluded_claims: No patient/resident/family personal data, no PHI/ePHI, no outcome claims

item: Hospitals, discharge planners, physicians, community partners, paid enquiries
allowed_no_sensitive_evidence: Source category, date bucket, non-sensitive status, owner, next action
owner_question: Which referral sources stall because ownership or next action is unclear?
excluded_claims: No partner endorsement, no admissions or census lift claim

item: Assessment scheduling, document checklist, consent/notice reminders, internal handoffs
allowed_no_sensitive_evidence: Checklist item, blocker type, owner, due window, resolution note
owner_question: Which blockers delay start-of-care promises and need human review?
excluded_claims: No clinical, legal, compliance, billing or staffing advice

item: Availability gaps, location fit, skill/language preference, cancellations, replacements
allowed_no_sensitive_evidence: Exception type, shift/date bucket, owner, escalation status
owner_question: Which scheduling exceptions need owner visibility before automation?
excluded_claims: No caregiver personnel file, labour advice or staffing guarantee

item: AI receptionist, answering service, CRM workflow, care-management workflow, dashboard
allowed_no_sensitive_evidence: Allowed task, stop-rule, escalation owner, approval requirement
owner_question: Which actions can be automated safely and which must stay human-reviewed?
excluded_claims: No autonomous clinical, emergency, eligibility, billing, safeguarding or compliance decisions

item: CRM, care-management, scheduling, answering service, AI receptionist, dashboard, AICS implementation
allowed_no_sensitive_evidence: Current tool category, pain point, evidence gap, safe next step
owner_question: Should the agency clean the process, buy software, add service coverage or scope implementation first?
excluded_claims: No vendor ranking, platform certification, procurement approval, revenue/savings/ROI guarantee
